Local CSP patch (2026-11-23): replaces the three eager
Function('id', 'return import(id)') initializers in the official bundle with
fixed functions that reject optional dynamic-module loads. This worker never
uses optional modules; the patch removes the only startup eval path while
failing those unrelated features closed. The worker's fixed GeoJSON import,
topology, weighted simplify, keep-shapes and GeoJSON export path is verified
under the production CSP.
Patched bundle SHA-256: f11c8eb91a5072730db86f88d77873285114eba1ea657d197c1660de4caa17ee

The local worker exposes only a fixed weighted simplification with 1..100%
retention, topology construction and keep-shapes. It uses Mapshaper's browser
API directly instead of its command parser, so it does not expose a console,
expressions, URL imports, scripts, dynamic evaluation or remote resources.
